author: Russell Brand
description:
Robert Malone argues that fear is one of the most powerful tools available to those seeking greater control. From Covid to the climate crisis, he sees a recurring pattern in which threats are amplified, fear overwhelms our ability to think clearly, and authorities arrive offering the solution. The conversation turns to how we can recognise that pattern—and why strong communities may be one of our best defences against it.

Curativa Bay is a veteran-owned American company that has been pioneering stabilized hypochlorous acid (HOCl) technology since 2016 — years before HOCl became a mainstream skincare, disinfectant, and wellness ingredient. Hypochlorous acid is a molecule naturally produced by the body's immune system. Curativa Bay has spent nearly a decade refining stabilized HOCl formulations designed for everyday applications ranging from skincare and wound care to personal hygiene, pet care, and non-toxic home cleaning.
